device.type: DVB-T2/C Full HD terrestrial and cable receiver with Conax / MultiCAS card reader, Ethernet and USB PVR
device.soc: ALi M3821A (128 MB DDR3 dual-CPU DVB-T2/C SoC reading chip ID 0x3821, revision B; NIM_S3821_0 / NIM_QAM_S3281, seecode "M3606 SEE" at 0xA6000200)

source.author: Amiko
source.note: Archive AMIKO_ECO_TC-200_2.3.17_emu.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-04.

simulator.note: Boots as a dual-CPU XIP M3821 board (chips/m3821.py, run_dump_eco_tc200_2317_app_starts.py, run_dump_eco_tc200_2317_capture_screen.py): the XIP bootloader uses cache-as-RAM until DDR3 is up, drives the CH455 panel on GPIO 128 / 129 ("CH455 panel init OK!", " ON "), parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA1016804, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") and maincode(AV) ("22000A882317", 12.16 MB) via LZMA, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE at 0xA6000200 with EBase 0x86002001).  The application attaches PAN_CH455_0 ("---led 455 attach OK--", " on ") and renders its 1280x720 OSD dialog through GE_M36F.

desc: Amiko Eco TC-200 (System ID 22000A88) firmware v2.3.17 EMU (2017-4-26) for the Full HD DVB-T2/C terrestrial and cable receiver on the ALi M3821A SoC with 128 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.
Pairs an XIP "M3821A 1.1.1" bootloader with a dual-CPU maincode(AV) + "M3606 SEE" co-processor build and a CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 128 (SCL) / 129 (SDA).
